caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher or jug rendered in pencil on a cream-colored background. The pitcher has an elongated body that tapers at the neck and widens toward the middle, then narrows again towards the base. It features a prominent, curved spout and a single, decorative handle with a scroll-like pattern at the top. The body of the pitcher is adorned with a floral motif on the widest part, and a dotted or beaded line circles the upper portion near the neck. The vessel stands on a short pedestal that sits atop a square base. Shading is used to represent the metallic form and texture, with areas of light and shadow giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed schematic sketch of the same pitcher, showing its proportions and some measurements. The artist's name, "NICHOLAS ZUPA," is written in small capital letters in the bottom right corner. The entirety of the drawing is enclosed within a thin, hand-drawn border.
title: Silver Creamer
